title: Digi International to Release Third Fiscal Quarter 2020 Earnings Results and Host Conference Call on August 6, 2020
summary: Digi announced that it will release its financial results for the third fiscal quarter 2020 on Thursday, August 6, 2020, after market close.
body_markdown: Digi announced that it will release its financial results for the third fiscal quarter 2020 on Thursday, August 6, 2020, after market close.
